objective: Compare generation on ep x illiq mechanism truth with no literal truth-column names in the prompt examples. Structural example alignment and correlated proxies still limit attribution to independent hypothesis understanding.
query: 在给定的合成研究面板上，寻找对下月收益具有真实增量预测力的横截面因子假设。

dgp.seed_policy: Development seed blocks begin at 2110. Evaluation seeds 3000+ remain reserved; null panels use IC=0.
dgp.dealignment_check: Truth columns ep and illiq are absent from literal recipe/output examples. Structural example alignment is a separate limitation.

oracle.truth_definition: abs overall Spearman correlation between candidate values and the per-month-standardized injected mechanism signal std(F_ep * sign(F_illiq))
oracle.threshold_sensitivity: For a separate sensitivity analysis, recompute true-accept counts from saved candidate truth_loading values at thresholds 0.4 and 0.6; the runner classifies truth at the primary threshold 0.5.

glm.prompt_freeze_note: Recipe/output examples are frozen protocol inputs. Literal de-alignment does not remove structural form guidance.

interpretation.primary_metric: pooled per-trial true-accept rate on alternative panels (true = would-be ACCEPT with truth loading >= 0.5)
interpretation.decision_rule: A comparison is CONFIRMED for a side only when its Wilson 95% lower bound exceeds the other side's Wilson 95% upper bound; overlapping intervals read INCONCLUSIVE; either side below minimum_pooled_trials reads INSUFFICIENT_DATA. No point-estimate-only claims.
interpretation.clustering_caveat: Trials cluster within seeds; per-seed discovery counts are reported alongside and any writeup must state the number of independent seeds.

comparisons.Q1_model_beyond_template: GLM cells with recipe_prompt=true (pooled) vs recipe_random arms (pooled).
comparisons.Q2_recipe_prompt_effect: Recipe-prompt on versus off, pooled over other factors. Recipe prompting also changes the output example; the contrast does not isolate recipe text alone.
comparisons.Q3_vocabulary_effect: GLM narrow vs wide vocabulary (pooled over other factors).
comparisons.Q4_hard_constraint_effect: GLM hard cross-family constraint on vs off (pooled over other factors).
comparisons.floor_glm_vs_random: All GLM cells pooled vs pure-random arms.

interpretation.null_rule: Pooled null accepts per trial reported with Wilson upper bound against the 0.1 target; with 2 null seeds this is DESCRIPTIVE ONLY.

recipe_conformance_policy: Declared recipes are structurally host-validated and recorded; non-conformance does not block oracle evaluation.
execution_note: Local baseline arms need no credentials. GLM cells require GLM_API_KEY; resume individual arms with --arms and quote comma lists in PowerShell.
